title: Recovering Assignments with One-Sided Noise
summary: We study the query complexity of recovering a planted assignment from a random constraint-satisfaction instance with one-sided noise. We consider the following 1-CNF recovery problem: an unknown binary string with $n/2$ ones and $n/2$ zeros is queried at individual variables. A query to a $1$-variable returns "$1$" with probability $p$ and "$0$" otherwise, while a $0$-variable always returns "$0$" (each query is a fresh noisy draw).
